name: Netorare Inbo Bukken ~Sayaka~
original_name: 寝取られ淫母物件～沙也加～
source:
Sayaka and her son Kazuya live together in an old apartment.

Although their life is not in affluence, they have lived peacefully without troubles.

However, a tiny crack appears in their modest daily life as the uneventful 
circumstance surrounding Sayaka and her heart and mind show signs of change!!


But one day... It was all of a sudden that Sayaka disappeared.

Days after the disappearance of Sayaka, a DVD is sent to her son Kazuya...

The DVD is labeled as "from Sayaka"...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE221849.html]DLsite English[/url]]
